## Goal

Remove the legacy `rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check` CLI/direct-engine command and its persisted `.bridge_state/reconcile-check.json` artifact without breaking the canonical bridge surfaces that replaced its observables (ticket 3b66 distributed them): `rebar bridge preview` = live Jira-vs-local differ; `rebar bridge fsck --output json` = offline orphan/unbound/binding-drift audit; `rebar bridge status --json` = status surface (which must stop reading the stale legacy artifact once its writer is deleted). The pause sentinel `gated_mode == "reconcile-check"` is NOT the CLI command and must be preserved byte-for-byte.

## Scope

- `_bridge_runner.py`: repoint the retained `reconcile-check` runner profile to `rebar bridge preview` (NOT `bridge fsck`).
- `_cli/_registry.py`: remove the legacy top-level `rebar reconcile` route.
- `_cli/_parsers/advanced/reconcile.py` + `_cli/help/reconcile.txt`: remove the `--mode reconcile-check` and `--filter-local-ids` CLI surface + help.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`: delete `_run_reconcile_check`, its `reconcile-check.json` writer, the `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK` dispatch branch, and CLI-only `filter_local_ids` handoff.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/request.py`: remove legacy-route `--mode reconcile-check` + `--filter-local-ids` parsing; keep canonical `preview`/`sync` normalization.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/mode.py`: remove `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK`, its `_ORDERED` entry, and its `MODE_CAPS` entry.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/_preflight.py`: remove reconcile-check from no-write/preflight logic + docs.
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/last_pass.py`: remove `_read_reconcile_diagnostics()` and the `reconcile_diagnostics` surfacing (no canonical writer remains).
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile_check.py`: delete the orphaned legacy report module.
- Comment/docstring-only cleanups (behavior unchanged): `binding_recovery.py`, `binding_walk.py`, `fetcher.py`, `get_rotation.py`, `load_phase.py`, `pass_support.py`, `reconcile_helpers.py`, `ticket_planner.py`.
- `schemas/bridge_status.schema.json` + `types.py`: remove the retired `reconcile_diagnostics` field/typing.
- `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`, both `scripts/jira-pressure-test/*probe.sh`: migrate `reconcile-check` invocations to `bridge preview` (live) / `bridge fsck --output json` (audit).
- `docs`, `CHANGELOG.md`: document the distributed replacement + removal.
- `tests/*`: remove/update deleted-command tests; add held-out CLI-removal + pause-sentinel + diagnostics-retirement coverage.

## Design Decisions

1. `bridge fsck` is NOT the sole replacement — it is an offline audit that intentionally exits `1` on findings; it lacks the live Jira-vs-local report and legacy success semantics.
2. `_bridge_runner` maps `reconcile-check` → `bridge preview`: the runner treats nonzero provider exit as failure and skips delivery, so `bridge fsck`'s exit-1-on-findings would read as a runner failure.
3. `.bridge_state/reconcile-check.json` has NO canonical writer after `_run_reconcile_check` is deleted — do NOT invent one; remove the `last_pass.py` reader so `bridge status` cannot report stale diagnostics.
4. PRESERVE `_ref_lock.py` pause docs exactly (`gated_mode == "reconcile-check"`); it is NOT in the edit set.
5. Do NOT remove dead `filter_local_ids` engine plumbing beyond the CLI surface — follow-up `f8c4-ac9b-42c5-4bb0`.
6. Do NOT edit `_lib_ops.py`/`_mcp_reads.py` — public Python/MCP `rebar.reconcile(mode=...)` belongs to `c195-03cd-fc03-4ae0`, which MUST land first (recorded `depends_on`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_mode.py` proves `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK`, `_ORDERED["reconcile-check"]`, and `MODE_CAPS[RECONCILE_CHECK]` are gone while dry-run/bootstrap/live ordering still works.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py` proves `python -m rebar_reconciler --mode reconcile-check` is rejected and `_run_reconcile_check` is no longer dispatched.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py` proves `_bridge_runner.MODE_COMMANDS["reconcile-check"]` invokes `rebar bridge preview` with runner delivery semantics preserved (not `bridge fsck`).
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/bridge/test_bridge_fsck_binding_drift.py` proves orphan/unbound/drift buckets remain available via canonical `bridge fsck --output json`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_relocated_store.py` proves `bridge status` still reports last-pass/pause/live-lock but no longer reads/surfaces stale `.bridge_state/reconcile-check.json`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py` proves pause docs preserve `gated_mode == "reconcile-check"` byte-for-byte.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_reconcile_check_cli_removal_heldout.py` (held-out oracle) proves the CLI spelling is rejected, canonical guidance is present, and `git grep "reconcile-check" -- src/rebar tests docs .github Jenkinsfile scripts` finds only the preserved pause sentinel or documented historical/changelog references.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck` pass.
- [ ] `env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=4 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_3=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_3=all PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test` passes.

## Testing

Held-out oracle `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_reconcile_check_cli_removal_heldout.py` plus the targeted pytest selectors named inline in the Acceptance Criteria, then the three full gates (`make test` with the env-artifact sanitizer above, `make lint`, `make typecheck`).
